subtitles.zh: 这些头条数字里，有什么让你对Rishi产生疑虑的地方吗？
subtitles.en: Anything here that you equiple that Rishi with the guards of some of these headline numbers?

subtitles.zh: 谢谢邀请，很高兴来。整体数字确实比担心的要好。
subtitles.en: Yeah, look, and thanks much for having me. Always a pleasure to be here. Look, I think the numbers across the board were definitely better than feared.

subtitles.zh: 之前有融资方面的担忧，也有关于RPO积压订单转化为收入时间线的担忧，
subtitles.en: There were concerns around financing, concerns around the timeline of being able to turn the backlog that's sitting in RPO into revenue,

subtitles.zh: 但本季度OCI超预期，且指引上调，
subtitles.en: clearly with the over-achievement on OCI in the quarter and the raised guide.

subtitles.zh: 这些担忧可能暂时缓解了。
subtitles.en: I think that some of those worries might be temporarily put to rest.

subtitles.zh: 如果要挑刺，可能是在应用软件收入上。
subtitles.en: If I were to say, what am I poking at here? Probably it's the app's revenue.

subtitles.zh: 他们的应用软件和传统软件已经出现疲软。
subtitles.en: There has already been weakness in their application software and some of their traditional software.

subtitles.zh: 现在可能还有裁员的影响叠加。
subtitles.en: And now you have maybe potentially the impact of RIFS layering on that.

subtitles.zh: 所以这条线可能进一步放缓。但很明显，当前股价几乎完全取决于OCI和RPO。
subtitles.en: So we might see further deceleration in that line. But I think very clear right now, the stock trades almost entirely on OCI and RPO at these levels.

subtitles.zh: 我很好奇，这只权益资产至少跑赢板块两三年了，甚至更久。
subtitles.en: Well, I am curious. I mean, you've had a sector perform on the stock for at least a couple of years, or maybe even more than that.

subtitles.zh: 那么请谈谈，潜在的上行空间在哪里。
subtitles.en: So give me a sense here as to what any potential upside is.

subtitles.zh: 信不信由你，一年前的今天，这只权益资产创下了历史新高。
subtitles.en: I mean, this stock hit a record high, believe it or not, on this day one year ago.

subtitles.zh: 当然，此后就再也没有接近过那个高点。
subtitles.en: And of course, hasn't been anywhere near that record high since.

subtitles.zh: 是的，你看，我持怀疑态度的一部分原因，也是我一直观望的原因，即便在星际之门大交易的高峰期，也主要是围绕增长的持久性。
subtitles.en: Yeah, look, I think part of my skepticism and why I've been on the sidelines even at the peak of the large Stargate deal was really around kind of the durability of growth.

subtitles.zh: 我们确实预计，仅仅因为甲骨文云基础设施有过剩产能，就会有一些顺风。
subtitles.en: We definitely expected that just by having excess capacity on Oracle Cloud infrastructure, that there would be some tailwinds.

subtitles.en: clearly with the over-achievement on OCI in the quarter and the raised guide.

subtitles.zh: 这些担忧可能暂时缓解了。
subtitles.en: I think that some of those worries might be temporarily put to rest.

subtitles.zh: 如果要挑刺，可能是在应用软件收入上。
